answer: Each identity posts bonded collateral in escrow, and signed attestations make equivocation linkable. When k identities coordinate conflicting claims, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), while asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss upon detection. Controlling a sybil swarm therefore increases, rather than masks, exposure: a knoll, cipher, or saffron-labeled cluster remains economically prohibitive.
